annotation.summary_en: ISO store catalogue page for ISO 13849-1:2023 (4th edition, April 2023), the international standard on design of safety-related parts of machinery control systems. It sets a methodology for safety functions in high-demand/continuous modes, excludes security aspects, and does not prescribe specific performance levels. Foundational for robot and machinery safety.
key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies methodology and requirements for design and integration of safety-related parts of control systems (SRP/CS), including software
Applies to high demand and continuous modes of operation, regardless of technology
Does not apply to low demand mode (see IEC 61508)
Does not specify safety functions or required performance levels for particular applications
Does not provide specific cybersecurity measures; refers to ISO/TR 22100-4 and IEC/TR 63074
